hook: Your phone can put one person in a photo twice.
title: Your Phone Can Put You in a Photo Twice
description:
Panorama mode stitches slices taken over a few seconds, so a person who moves can appear twice. Have someone stand in the scene, sweep the phone past them, and let them run behind you to the far side. It works on any phone with panorama mode. Part of the Phone Tests series.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Panorama
comment_prompt: Did it work for you? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone can put one person in a photo twice.
scenes.headline: TWO OF THE SAME PERSON

scenes.narration: Open panorama mode and start sweeping.
scenes.headline: OPEN PANORAMA

scenes.narration: Have a friend stand in the scene.
scenes.headline: FRIEND STANDS STILL

scenes.narration: Once the camera passes them, they run.
scenes.headline: THEN THEY RUN

scenes.narration: They sprint behind you to the far side.
scenes.headline: SPRINT TO THE OTHER SIDE

scenes.narration: The camera finds them there again.
scenes.headline: CAMERA FINDS THEM AGAIN

scenes.narration: Tap done, and the same person appears twice.
scenes.headline: SAME PERSON, TWICE

scenes.narration: Panorama is not one shot, it is many slices.
scenes.headline: MANY SLICES STITCHED

scenes.narration: Your phone just stitched two moments together.
scenes.headline: TWO MOMENTS, ONE PHOTO

scenes.narration: Try it, and your phone makes two of you.
scenes.headline: TRY IT YOURSELF
